dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular light-toned closed loops and semi-circular 'C' shapes exhibit soft-edged gradients transitioning from dark charcoal backgrounds to pale grey interiors, most prominent along the mid-dorsal and lateral-right surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of amorphous high-intensity light patches concentrated in the upper posterior region, showing less structural definition than the annuli and becoming increasingly sparse toward the caudal peduncle.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented along the longitudinal axis of the body.
